services.title: Auto repair
services.body: Vehicles are diagnosed and repaired at the actual fault before anything gets replaced.

reviews.author: Chris Walker
reviews.text: As a black veteran he has serviced me and my family for years. He works with you on prices and is straightforward. I stand by him fully

reviews.author: Timothy Bennett
reviews.text: I must say Jb and his son Tim with the rest of the crew do outstanding work at fare or below prices compared to other big auto shops and always let you know upfront before any work is done. I've been a loyal customer for 7yrs.

reviews.author: Tenisha
reviews.text: When I moved to moncks corner 3 years ago, my transmission went out. I started searching the web for mechanics that specializes in transmission. I found JB's transmission and auto repair. I spoke to Jack and he explained the process. Jack will figure out the exact problem with your vehicle before taking any money. If he doesn't find anything wrong, he is not taking your money nor will he make up anything just to get your money. Jack and his team are honest and take pride in their work. I have been going to Jack for all of my repairs for the past 3 years. Jack and his team goes above and beyond. Thank you for the great work that you do so I can get back on the road as in a timely manner.

reviews.author: Chris Walker
reviews.text: I was quoted a lot for an simple repair on coolant system at Firestone, took it to jbs instead and he gave very reasonable price. He also allowed my family to wait in their waiting room while they did the work quick.

reviews.author: ellen cantwell
reviews.text: Super nice people. Quick, efficient, and fair. We will definitely be back for future needs. Thanks so much for taking care of my Tahoe.

reviews.author: Cheri Stephenson
reviews.text: Jack and team are the only one working on my truck. They are honest and fair. I have been happy with my multiple interactions. I am happy to be a return customer!

reviews.author: P. McMillan
reviews.text: JB's transmission and auto repair they are awesome. They listen to you. Thank you for the job well done. I would recommend them to all my friends and family. Mr Jack and his mechanics take time to talk to you let you know exactly what needs to be done I tell them talk to me like 'I'm a two-year-old'. it's refreshing to know you have some mechanics that won't take you to the bank being a female if you don't know you could be spending a lot of money but at JB's transmission and auto repair they are fair honest very professional almost like family.

reviews.author: Krai Treadway
reviews.text: Was gonna replace my transmission myself but in order to keep the 5yr 100k warranty valid it needed to be done at a transmission shop. I prefer local businesses so I decided to let these guys give it a go. Dropped my truck off after hours Friday. Someone was nice enough to stay late for me to do so. They had quite a few cars up there so I expected a wait before I got it back. No sir. Got it back in 3 business days. Thanks gentleman, will be coming back for future repairs that are out of my hands.

reviews.author: Tanya Driggers
reviews.text: Jack Brown really has done an exceptional job every time I’ve needed my car repaired. He listens and gets down to the root cause of the issue. He is very reliable and best of all very trustworthy. I don’t go anywhere else! He’s my first call every time! Thank you Jack! Tanya Driggers

reviews.author: Monster Benzzz
reviews.text: My Mercedes needed suspension work and to be sure they fixed the correct thing, they drove it before and after fixing it vs just saying so.

reviews.author: Kelly Furrows
reviews.text: They quickly diagnosed the issue and were very straightforward about what needed fixing and they quickly took care of it. I appreciate their honesty and that they aren’t looking to take advantage of someone with minimal knowledge on cars. My car is driving so much better now; it feels brand new! I will recommend J B’s to anyone who needs car maintenance.

reviews.author: Latoya Gibbs
reviews.text: Very very honest people. I brought my Durango in October 2020 because my car wouldn't turn over. I thought it was the crank sensor but it turned out to be the timing chain. He worked with me and was very honest about the steps I needed to take, you will NOT get that integrity anywhere else.! Very very honest! I appreciate that more than anything.

reviews.author: Halle Mosser
reviews.text: I was moving from Florida earlier that morning when my transmission started acting up. I called a Firestone in the area and told me they did not have the resources to work on my transmission but recommended me to JB's. I had a horrible move and Jack and the staff was the only part that went smoothly. They took my car promptly despite being extremely busy and were kind and communicative through the process.

reviews.author: Bill Jefferson
reviews.text: I took my Chevy Avalanche to these guys for a transmission rebuild. Said it would be 4-5 days. They had my truck for 3 weeks. I picked it up and it failed before I got down the road 2 miles. Took it back and they had it another week and it failed the next day. Cost me $1600.00. Now I have to spend time and money to try and get my money back. I took it to another transmission shop and turns out they had install a used transmission pump from an earlier model transmission that does not cross to be the same part so it failed. They also charged me for parts that were never installed. These guys are bad news. DO NOT make the same mistake I did.

reviews.author: Bobby Bosler
reviews.text: Seemed like an honest guy. Everyone I’ve talked to said he does good work for an honest price. I, however, wasn’t able to use his services because he doesn’t have a lift big enough to handle a long bed, crew cab, one-ton truck.

reviews.author: Michael Strickland
reviews.text: Had a transmission rebuilt. Installed. Wouldn’t move. Asked for help. They refused. Ignored completely. Didn’t care. Very rude. Was cursed out: I would never do business with them again.

reviews.author: Shayla Shanae
reviews.text: Great service I’m actually a third generation customer my granddad used JB services for his car dealership and now Mr. Timmy is running it his son and me and my mom go to get our car serviced there very pleasant experience the crew is friendly and straight to the point as well thank you

reviews.author: Joe Towles
reviews.text: Went by to get transmission problem scanned..identified and is getting me in Monday a.m. for repair..very professional!! Thanks Jack

reviews.author: Caitlin Daniels
reviews.text: He was great. Had us ready in less than an hour and was really nice. Kept me informed and explained what went wrong. Fair pricing.

reviews.author: Martha Blunt
reviews.text: Really great service and friendly staff. They listened to my concerns about my car, then got to work immediately.

reviews.author: Clay Hardy
reviews.text: I appreciate the work that they do here. My husband told me about this place and I have not been disappointed. This place is a GEM.

reviews.author: Rosa Thieman
reviews.text: Thieven. The transmission service was complete, okay, and it was reasonable priced, and done in a timely fashion which I appreciate. But my car was literally on the lift the whole time and somehow I’m missing $400 worth of tools, ALL my change left in my vehicle, my car ordainment, THAT WAS VELCROED TO MY DASH, and my tampon bag from my center console; then I’m missing a pair of crocs, and a Nike wind breaker from my trunk. Oh, and my damn sunglasses that where in my sunglasses compartment over head, (I did take photos of everything whilst in their lot before leaving the vehicle, cus my vehicle was broken down, unable to be driven and I had to call an Uber, since I’m from NYS just visiting). Spent near $4,000, Just to get stolen from. Then trying to portray it as someone might have taken my stuff out my vehicle when they pulled it off the lift, and onto the lot the night before we picked up my vehicle, no signs of a break in though. The owner himself played back the video and even admitted no one went into my vehicle when it was placed in the lot yard, but if that was the case, I’m positive that my car jack and stands would have also gone missing as well, since my $400 worth of other tools where stacked on top of it, and then your implying you don’t lock vehicles on your lot? Which he confirmed, informing me he was, “advised by Berkley Country” not to lock the vehicles. Which dosent make sense to me, since as a genuine business should have lot insurance, and I as a driver have automotive insurance as well. Just mind blowing, if the lot cameras show no signs of anyone going into my vehicle (cus all my cars lights would have lite up like a Christmas tree as well) and the owner even acknowledged this, it’s safe to assume one of the employees, perhaps one that knows where the cameras are pointing and knows how to avoid them stole my property, or everyone was in on the act. That, and parts not clipped in after the repair, and instead of unscrewing things in my motor we’re just ripping things apart? Ridiculous in my opinion. I don’t normally make reviews and I’m not just doing this for sh*t and giggles. But when, on top of all this the owner Jack texts me off his personal phone telling me, “I was trying to tell you I would give you $300 to help resolve this” and “ I will not leave you hanging”, (which I saved those screen shots too) it’s just wildly suspicious.
